description:
App2Proxy lets you redirect the traffic of selected apps through a local proxy using iptables. Due to the use of iptables, the app requires root access.
Features:
• Selective traffic redirection: choose specific applications for proxying
• Automatic restoration of iptables rules after reboot
• Support for system apps with advanced mode
• DNS management: redirect DNS requests to port 10853
• Material 3 design with dark theme and AMOLED support
• Autorun with support for Android 15+ and various manufacturers
• Autoload diagnostics to troubleshoot problems
• Rule manager to view and manage active rules
